answer: Reputation Decay Tax: each identity pays a small fixed ledger fee per action, and its fee multiplier rises with the number of actions taken after its last independent beacon confirmation. A fresh identity starts high, so spinning up raven swarms costs linearly in fees before any payoff. Sable coordinators must fund decay resets across many identities, and each split multiplies total spend. The attacker's per-identity cost grows superlinearly with fleet size, making mass sybils uneconomic without blocking honest newcomers.
